_label: Heuristic / demo thresholds. These bands are chosen for the SIH 2026 prototype walkthrough and are NOT calibrated psychometric cut-offs. Tune them per domain before any real use.
separability_method: Jensen-Shannon divergence with log base 2 (symmetric, bounded in [0,1]).
overall_separability_weighting: Equal weight across all target-state pairs (unweighted arithmetic mean of pairwise JSD).
